records.notes: All-system aggregate row for 46 franchise territories operating at least 12 months as of December 31, 2024. 2 of 48 territories excluded for operating less than 12 months. pct_above_avg is the % of franchisees at or above mean (29%), with 17 of 46 at or above mean. cohort_name set to open_12_24mo as the qualifying criterion is operating for at least 12 months; however this is effectively the all_franchised cohort minus ramp-up outlets.

notes: Item 19 discloses annual gross revenues for 46 Young Rembrandts franchise territories operating at least 12 months during calendar year 2024 (out of 48 total; 2 excluded for insufficient operating history). Data is broken out by quintile and for all 46 franchisees combined. Metrics reported: mean, median, high, low, count in segment, count at or above mean, and % at or above mean. OCR rendered some dollar values with spacing (e.g., '$280,03 1', '$364,13 7') which were normalized to correct values based on context. The 5th quintile row shows % above mean as 4 and count above mean as 5 — these are nearest whole numbers per the document's own note. The cohort_name for the aggregate row is approximated as open_12_24mo since the qualifying criterion is 12+ months of operation; there is no upper bound stated.
